sampling_model.design: One stationary iid-response SCM generates the factual record; an independent generative calibration experiment supplies rowwise multinomial draws.
sampling_model.units: The causal query concerns one unit observed for \(T\) transitions; calibration units are independent across draws and rows.
sampling_model.treatment: The factual and alternative interventions are the fixed stationary policies \(b\) and \(\pi\).
sampling_model.overlap: Known nominal support with \(P(y\mid x,a)\ge\epsilon\) on each positive cell; no response-program mass is bounded away from zero.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The controlled transition law is either known or estimated by \(\widehat P\) from independent rowwise multinomial calibration samples; no trajectory-only nuisance estimator is claimed.

body.tldr: A known finite controlled transition law leaves the same unit's counterfactual path partially identified because it does not select a response-program coupling. The unconditional complete-fiber result proved here is an explicit \(O(\!\sqrt{\log T/T}\!)\) expected-diameter bound, with no response-mass floor and no contraction assumption on conditional counterfactual kernels. The synchronizer--two-permutation recursion is now embedded in an explicit legal binary SCM: its Poisson martingale is exactly one half of the recursion sum, its reward range maps exactly to a causal-interval subrange, every fixed parameter has root-\(T\) scale, and all three boundary edges satisfy a \(13\sqrt T\) maximal bound. The two-dimensional interior and the complete-fiber root-\(T\) upper bound remain open; the established full-support binary lower theorem rules out any uniformly faster rate. Haugh--Singal's narrower casino model instead assumes exogenous noise vectors independent across time, independent transition and emission noise, a direct fair-die hidden-state intervention, time-homogeneous emission-coupling ambiguity, and an irreducible aperiodic hidden chain, and proves asymptotic full identification of time-averaged EWAC. No class inclusion or transfer is asserted.

project_justification.gap: The closest long-record comparator, HaughSingal2026Casino, works under exogenous noise vectors independent across time, independence of transition and emission noise, a direct intervention fixing the hidden state to the fair die, ambiguity only in the time-homogeneous emission coupling, and an irreducible aperiodic hidden chain. It proves asymptotic full identification of time-averaged EWAC in that setting, but does not give this note's finite uniform rate over the complete stationary response-program fiber. No embedding or class inclusion between the two models is used. Existing one-transition compatible-coupling bounds, finite canonical programs, and fixed-kernel Poisson concentration likewise do not evaluate the posterior-normalized whole-polytope supremum at vanishing response masses.
project_justification.niche: The unresolved sharp question is whether the explicit complete-fiber \(O(\!\sqrt{\log T/T}\!)\) upper certificate can be improved to root-\(T\), matching the full-support feedback lower witness. The legal synchronizer--two-permutation triangle isolates the first nontrivial interior obstruction without changing the causal graph, response stationarity, support condition, or Poisson condition.
project_justification.fill: This round supplies an unconditional whole-polytope logarithmic certificate and a fully legal binary kill-test construction. It proves the exact identities connecting the triangle to \(M_T(q)\), the full-record counterfactual reward, and the sharp compatible interval; it also proves root-\(T\) control pointwise and on the triangle's complete boundary. These are the strongest established statements. The interior triangle maximal inequality and the general root-\(T\) localization are not claimed.

body.related_work: HaughSingal2026Casino, arXiv version 3, pages 9--11, Sections 4.2--4.3, assumes exogenous noise vectors independent across time, independence of transition and emission noise, a direct intervention fixing the hidden state to the fair die, ambiguity only in a time-homogeneous emission coupling, and an irreducible aperiodic hidden chain; it proves asymptotic full identification of time-averaged EWAC under those restrictions. This note neither asserts an embedding nor transfers that result to the complete stationary response-program fiber. LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP gives sharp one-transition compatible-SCM bounds, and ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCounterfactual supplies generic finite canonical-SCM optimization, but neither gives a long-record uniform rate for one stationary response law reused across dates. SayedanaCainesMahajan2025 supplies the fixed-kernel Poisson telescoping move; the additional issue here is uniformity over posterior-conditioned response laws. HaughSingal2023DynamicLatent gives finite-record dynamic latent-state programs without a record-length contraction theorem. The self-normalized and sequential-complexity tools in deLaPenaLaiShao2009 and RakhlinSridharanTewari2015 motivate possible maximal arguments, but no theorem from either source is invoked as if it evaluated this boundary-singular response-filter family. OberstSontag2019 and LorberbomJohnsonMaddisonTarlowHazan2021 select or study particular couplings rather than the entire compatible interval. KaidoMolinariStoye2019CalibratedProjection motivates nuisance-region projection; the separate confidence-fiber result uses finite-sample rowwise coverage and deterministic set inclusion.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The complete-fiber proof uses an internal \(\ell_1\)-net of radius \(\epsilon T^{-3/2}\); its entropy produces the \(\sqrt{\log T}\) gap. The exact legal triangle proof removes the earlier causal-embedding ambiguity and controls its three edges, including noncontracting corners, but it does not control a record-dependent optimizer in the two-dimensional interior. No horizon-dependent parameter sequence with divergent root-\(T\)-normalized width has been proved either. Thus the present unconditional headline is the \(O(\!\sqrt{\log T/T}\!)\) complete-polytope bound, not the conditional root-\(T\) corollary.
body.honest_scope: Every proved width bound is an expectation at its stated deterministic sample length. There is no recordwise or anytime shrinkage claim: rare factual records may retain unit diameter. The result assumes one stationary iid response law shared across dates and hidden branches, but imposes neither a positive lower bound on its masses nor contraction of every conditional counterfactual kernel. The Poisson equation with a common scalar average reward is essential; absorbing target models with class-dependent reward averages fall outside the theorem. The legal triangle establishes a causal lower-transfer mechanism and root-\(T\) boundary control, not an interior or whole-polytope root-\(T\) theorem. The Haugh--Singal comparison is descriptive only, with no unproved model-class inclusion.
